name: JoAi: List Products

description.en: View all products and materials in your team catalog with names and prices.
description.de: Alle Produkte und Materialien im Team-Katalog mit Namen und Preisen anzeigen.

bot: Use this when the user wants to see their available products, materials, or billable items that can be used for invoices.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug to list products for. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug, für das Produkte angezeigt werden. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team whose products to list. Omit to use the current team.
